book.name: Mwɛɛ mù Jiso gɛ̀ dunyɛ
book.title: Ŋwa wu mwɛɛ mù Jiso gɛ̀ dunyɛ Joŋ le

content: Ntuŋ wù Jiso wù gɛɛne fɛ kintaashɛ ki bamii ba mbɛmɛ ki Ɛfɛsu le
Muh wù ŋgɛ̀ n'yɛŋ wɛɛ jɛmɛ mɛne lɛ,

content.text: “Sâŋ ŋwa fɛ nchɛndaa wu Nyo wu kintaashɛ ki bamii ba mbɛmɛ ki Ɛfɛsu le lɛ, ‘Wunɛ le njɛmɛ wù wuwɛɛ wù jiji jóŋ yì bvusooshwi le a kibo ke kinchiɛɛŋ le, wu jiɛnyi antɛnɛɛ a mwɛɛ mù bvusooshwi mù ba kɛnyi bɛ kichwa ki bige kì yɛɛde mù ba toome bin'yesɛ yu we:

Ŋkee gee chena bɛ no bɛŋ lɛne bɛŋ bunyi, ŋkee tɛ shɛ́ŋ yì bɛŋ kaane bɛ no taŋlo bɛŋ gɛ bɛɛŋ fiɛɛ fì bamii ba befe too bɛ fi le gɛ. Bɛŋ le bɛŋ moŋ wa bamii baa ba tɛŋe bikwɛɛ biboo lɛ bo le booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso bo ya nyume gɛ, bɛŋ yɛŋ lɛ bo le bamii ba chimbiaŋ.
Ŋkee no bɛŋ kaane shɛ́ŋ chuule yi fiɛɛ le fichii nje mɛ bɛŋ fwɛɛne gɛ.
Geenɛ, fiɛɛ fimi le yu fì ŋkɛme kune bɛŋ fì baaŋ joŋ gɛ mɛne gɛ. Gɛ bɛŋ baaŋ bɛŋ kɛme kiŋkoŋɛ kì bɛŋ gɛ̀ shee bɛŋ kɛme fweele gɛ.

Bɛŋ kwâjɛ no bɛŋ gɛ̀ shee bɛŋ nyume fɛ bɛŋ ja bɛŋ gwe. Bɛŋ kûsɛ muntele mwɛna bɛŋ kâasɛ bɛŋ gêe no bɛŋ gɛ̀ gee fweele. Nɛ bɛŋ baaŋ kusɛ gɛ, ŋge ntô nchîaasɛ fiɛɛ fiena fì ba toome kin'yesɛ yu fɛ fi lɛmɛ fo.
Geenɛ, fiɛɛ fì kooji fì bɛŋ gee le lɛ bɛŋ banɛ gee chi ŋgoo yi bamii ba Nikola, nyu fiɛɛ fì mbanɛ tɛ.

Muh wù kɛme bintuŋ, wu yû fiɛɛ fì Kiyo ki Nyo jɛme bintaashɛ bi bamii ba mbɛmɛ le. Muh wù lé wu gê wu sô, nlé ŋgê nyâ je wu jî muntaŋ mu kite kì nyaa kinche, kì le fɛ kijusɛ ki njoŋ wu Nyo le.’”

content: Ntuŋ wu Jiso wù gɛɛne fɛ kintaashɛki bamii ba mbɛmɛ ki Simina
Muh wuyu ka wu jɛmɛ mɛne lɛ,

content.text: “Sâŋ ŋwa fɛ nchɛndaa wu Nyo wu kintaashɛ ki bamii ba mbɛmɛ ki Simina le lɛ, ‘Wunɛ le njɛme wù wuwɛɛ wù le wu Fwe, wu nyu kijimɛ. Le wu wù gɛ̀ kwe wu kaasɛ wu nyu yu:
Ŋkee baŋgɛ ba bɛŋ yɛne mo kifufe kena, geenɛ bɛŋ le bamii ba bvukugɛ. Ŋkee jɛ́ yì befe yì bamii jɛme kune bɛŋ. Bo tɛŋe bikwɛɛ biboo lɛ bo le Bajuu, bo nyu gɛ. Bo nyu yi ŋgoo yi Sataŋ le.

Keefɛ bɛŋ fâane baŋgɛ ba bɛŋ lé bɛŋ gê bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ le gɛ. Bɛŋ yêgɛ bɛŋ yû, debele le wa ki wu lêesɛ bɛŋ bamu yeh yi ncha le ki wu môŋ bɛŋ. Bɛŋ lé bɛŋ gê bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ ŋgɛ yi aju le yuufe. Mo nyume ki bɛŋ kwê, bɛŋ lɛ̂me gɛh bɛŋ tɛ̂ɛme, noo nlé ŋgê nnyâ kifo ki bvunfoŋ kì le kinche kì kage gɛ bɛŋ le.
Muh wù kɛme bintuŋ, wu yû fiɛɛ fì Kiyo ki Nyo jɛme bintaashɛ bi bamii ba mbɛmɛ le. Muh wù lé wu gê wu sô, gɛ kwe yì kiŋgane kinfɛɛ kûŋ wu le gɛ.’”

content: Ntuŋ wu Jiso wù gɛɛne fɛ kintaashɛki bamii ba mbɛmɛ ki Bɛgamu le
Wu ka wu jɛmɛ mɛne lɛ,

content.text: “Sâŋ ŋwa fɛ nchɛndaa wu Nyo wu kintaashɛ ki bamii ba mbɛmɛ ki Bɛgamu le lɛ, ‘Wunɛ le njɛmɛ wù wuwɛɛ wù kɛme nyo yì koode bimbe bichii:

Ŋkee fɛ bɛŋ chee fo. Bɛŋ chee fɛ kala wu Sataŋ le fo kibɛɛ. Geenɛ bɛŋ lɛme gɛh yi jee chaŋ le bɛŋ tɛɛme. Bɛŋ gɛ̀ baaŋ faŋ gɛ ki bɛŋ lêesɛ fitele yi ye yaŋ le yi aju Antiba wù muh waŋ wù nchiɛɛŋ le gɛ. Wu gɛ̀ jɛmɛ kune mɛ, ba yuuyɛ wu a bɛŋ ntɛnɛɛ fɛɛ fɛ Sataŋ chee fo.

Geenɛ, ŋkɛmɛ mwɛɛ mumu shige kune bɛŋ mù baaŋ mɛne joŋ gɛ. Bamii bamu le yu ŋgoo yɛne le bò bii n'yɛyɛ wù Balaaŋ gɛ̀ teefɛ Balak yu lɛ wu gê fiɛɛ fì booŋ ba Ishwala baŋsɛ yu bo gwe. Wu gɛ̀ ge bo jii mwɛɛ munjile mù ba ge kintanyɛ yu fɛ banyo le wu ka wu ge bo chee kinche ki nyiɛŋ yi kinjaŋ.
Le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no bɛŋ kɛme tɛ bamii bamu ŋgoo yɛne le bò bii n'yɛyɛ wu bamii ba Nikola le.
Noo, bɛŋ kûsɛ muntele mwɛna. Nɛ bɛŋ baaŋ kusɛ gɛ, tu nlé ntô kife kì shige le n'jû bamii bayu bɛ nyo yì bude a mɛ mu.

Muh wù kɛme bintuŋ, wu yû fiɛɛ fì Kiyo ki Nyo jɛme bintaashɛ bi bamii ba mbɛmɛ le. Muh wù lé wu gê wu sô, nlé ŋgê n'jô fɛ mana wù ba gɛ̀ nyilɛ le nnyâ wu yu, ŋka nnyâ wu tɛdɛ chì baaŋ chì ba saŋ jee chì fɛŋ yu muh nyume gɛ yu wù kee jee chiyu fede muh wù fi tɛdɛ chiyu gɛ.’”

content: Ntuŋ wu Jiso wù gɛɛne fɛ kintaashɛki bamii ba mbɛmɛ ki Tayatila le
Muh wuyu ka wu jɛmɛ mɛne lɛ,

content.text: “Sâŋ ŋwa fɛ nchɛndaa wu Nyo wu kintaashɛ ki bamii ba mbɛmɛ ki Tayatila le lɛ, ‘Wunɛ le njɛmɛ wu Mwa Nyo. Le wu wù ajii awe bɛɛde njɛ lɛmɛ chi ŋgu, bikaa bie le shiŋeshiŋe njɛ kichwa kì ba toŋ fɛ kilamɛ le:

Ŋkee gee chena, ŋkee no bɛŋ kɛme kiŋkoŋɛ, ŋkee tɛ fitele fì bɛŋ leese yi ye yaŋ le mo lɛme chì bɛŋ lɛne bɛ no bɛŋ kaane shɛ́ŋ. Ŋkee tɛ lɛ gee chena chì mɛɛse joŋe chi fede chì bɛŋ gɛ̀ kɛme fweele.

Geenɛ, fiɛɛ fimi le yu fì ŋkɛme kune bɛŋ fì baaŋ joŋ gɛ mɛne gɛ. Bɛŋ le bɛŋ chinɛ kwɛse wù Jɛsɛbɛl wɛɛ le wu tu wu gee fiɛɛ fì wu gee. Wu tɛŋe kikwɛɛ ke lɛ wu le muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo, wu lɛɛde bamii baŋ bɛ n'yɛyɛ we, wu gee bo gee kinche ki nyiɛŋ yi kinjaŋ, bo ka bo jii mwɛɛ munjile mù ba le ba ge kintanyɛ yu fɛ banyo le.
Nle nnya wu kife ki wu kûsɛ fitele fie, geenɛ wu faŋ ki wu kûsɛ kinche ke ki kinjikuu.
Bɛŋ yêgɛ bɛŋ yû, nlé ŋgê ntûŋ kinchɛŋ yi ye ye le ki ŋgîisɛ wu fɛnta mo bamii ba bɛ bo gee nyiɛŋ yi kinjaŋ bo ŋgɛɛse lo, fuge gɛ lɛ bo kusɛ bo gɛ ka bo bii gee chi kwɛse wuyu le gɛ.

Nlé ŋgê yûuyɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo. Noo, bintaashɛ bi bamii ba mbɛmɛ bichii mo bi kɛ̂ɛ lɛ le mɛ wù kee mwɛɛ mù le shɛ́ŋ yi bamii le bɛ mù le a muntele le. Nlé ŋgê nlâŋe muh wuchii mbii no lɛme che le.
Geenɛ, bɛŋ bamu baa ba le Tayatila ba lɛme gɛ fɛ wunɛ n'yɛyɛ le gɛ, gɛ bo yɛyi tɛ fiɛɛ fì bamii bamu tɛŋe lɛ mwɛɛ mu Sataŋ mù nyilɛ le gɛ, njɛme lɛ gɛ taŋlo ŋka ŋgɛɛ bvujijɛ bvumu ye yene le gɛ.
Fi le gɛh lɛ, bɛŋ jîjɛ fiɛɛ fì bɛŋ kɛme le fi tɛmɛ, gɛ̂ɛŋ bû no nlé ŋgê ntô.
Muh wù lé wu gê wu sô, wù gee lɛme chì ŋkoŋe wu gɛɛŋ wu mɛsɛ, nlé ŋgê nnyâ wu bɛ bvuŋga wu nyû awe a bituŋ.
Gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no Chii le wu nya bvuŋga mɛne, nlé ŋgê nnyâ bvuŋga wu sâge bɛ kitoomɛ ki kichvu, wu bwɛ̂ɛyi bi yu njɛ sháaŋ yì ba maa, yì ba bwɛɛyɛ bimbɛge le bimbɛge le.
Nlé ŋgê nnyâ tɛ wu bɛ joŋ yi a yule.
Muh wù kɛme bintuŋ, wu yû fiɛɛ fì Kiyo ki Nyo jɛme bintaashɛ bi bamii ba mbɛmɛ le.’”
